runtime.reviewer: qa_runtime_2021 (independent reviewer; did not author content/runtime changes)

passed.structural: Four paired-release checks passed; exact ordered 20+20 originals, compiled teaching/lesson resolution and complete fresh audit gates.

existingRuntimeBaseline.scope: Isolated Playwright and PGlite fixtures; real browser UI, simulated service boundaries.

visual.reviewed: All eight full solution captures and all eight full cumulative-hint captures for Q1 in both papers, both interfaces, mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x1000; representative unexpanded question images also inspected.

passed.releaseDiff: No runtime, authentication, scoring weights, attempt-history code or database schema changes. Roadmap changes only enable both 2021 interactive paper IDs in their existing pair.
passed.contentQARecordConsistency: Both independent content reports pass without pending blockers. They explicitly distinguish mathematical QA from runtime/production testing, and their scope is 20 originals +43 follow-ups for P1, 20 originals +50 follow-ups for P2, with 9 corrected existing records and 38 renewed existing relationships.

knownLimitations: Fitted source-PDF question images can have small text on narrow phones (for example P1 Q1). The existing enlargement dialog fits to screen; browser pinch zoom may be needed for substantial text enlargement. node.environment: Real local Chromium. Account/auth/RPC/storage use isolated synthetic fixtures; database policy tests use PGlite. No production student submissions.
